steps.headline: Feed
steps.body: Open the Feed tab to see open jobs near you.
steps.narration: Open the Feed tab. This is where open jobs near you appear.

steps.headline: Be seen
steps.body: Turn on your availability to get invited to jobs.
steps.narration: Turn on your availability, so clients can find you and invite you.

steps.headline: Open jobs near you
steps.body: Scroll to see the service, place and time for each job.
steps.narration: Scroll through the list. Each job shows the service, the place and the time. Nothing to type.

steps.headline: Filter by urgency
steps.body: Tap All, Urgent, Normal or Flexible to narrow the list.
steps.narration: Tap Urgent, Normal or Flexible to narrow the list by how soon the work is needed.

steps.headline: Job details
steps.body: Tap a job to read the tasks, the photos and where it is.
steps.narration: Tap a job to read the tasks, see the photos and check where it is.

steps.headline: Know your pay
steps.body: Job details show the Job price, Platform fee and what you receive.
steps.narration: Job details also show the job price, the platform fee, and what you receive.

steps.headline: Messages
steps.body: Chat with clients from the Messages tab.
steps.narration: Use the Messages tab to chat with clients about their jobs.

steps.headline: Find jobs
steps.body: On Home, tap Find jobs to jump to the list.
steps.narration: On Home, you can also tap Find jobs to jump straight to the list.
